Those of you who want to receive new rulings as they're made without wading
through the various forums, I've set up a Yahoo! group for you.

To subscribe, just send an email to vtes-rules...@yahoogroups.com

To view the archives (which don't yet exist, since I haven't posted any
messages there yet), check the web page:

http://groups.yahoo.com/group/vtes-rules/

Rules Team Rulings posts will be archived under the files section, as well.
